tool.on: Ghost movement: ON (click to turn off)
tool.ready: Ghost movement: off (click to move through walls)
tool.off: Ghost movement: turned off by the GM

clip.what: While this is on, you can move your own tokens straight through walls, doors and other creatures. Your tokens look see-through so you can tell it's on.
clip.on: It's on. Click again to walk normally.
clip.ready: Click to switch it on. Click again to switch it off.
clip.combat: It switches off while a fight is running on this map, and you can switch it back on when the fight ends.
clip.off: The GM has switched it off for now.
clip.vision: Careful: walking through a wall means you see what's on the other side.
clip.exempt: A fight is running: only your incorporeal creatures (Incorporeal Passage, Incorporeal Movement, Ethereal) pass through walls while it is on. Your other tokens walk normally until the fight ends.

combat.on: Ghost in combat: ON for this creature (it may move through walls during a fight). Click to turn off.
combat.off: Ghost in combat: off for this creature. Click to let it move through walls during a fight.
combat.feat: Ghost in combat: ON for this creature, granted by its {feat}. Nothing to switch.

gm.off: Player ghost movement: OFF (click to allow)
gm.exploration: Player ghost movement: exploration only (click to turn off)
gm.always: Player ghost movement: always allowed (click to turn off)

clip.what: Lets players move their own tokens through walls and creatures with the ghost button in their token tools. Your own unconstrained-movement tool is separate.
clip.modes: Click to turn it off for everyone. Click again to restore the previous mode. Choose between Exploration only and Always allowed in Settings, Pentaryn Movement.
clip.combat: Exploration only switches it off while a combat is running on the scene.

blocked.off: The GM has turned ghost movement off.
blocked.combat: Ghost movement is off while a fight is running on this map.

cleared.off: The GM turned ghost movement off. Your tokens are stopped by walls again.
cleared.combat: A fight started: ghost movement is off. Your tokens are stopped by walls again.

back.combat: The fight is over: ghost movement is available again. Click the ghost button under the Ruler to use it.
back.off: The GM allows ghost movement again. Click the ghost button under the Ruler to use it.
back.exempt: Your incorporeal creature may move through walls during the fight. Click the ghost button under the Ruler to use it.

named.noRoute: No route there: {name} is in the way. The ghost button under the Ruler lets you pass.
named.stayed: Stayed where they stand, with no free spot they can reach: {names}.

notify.fightGroup: In a fight, drag one token at a time.

policy.name: Player ghost movement
policy.hint: Lets players move their own tokens through walls and creatures with a ghost button in the token tools. Exploration only switches it off while a combat is running on the scene. The GM toolbar button next to it flips this off and back on.

ownedOnTop.name: Show my own tokens on top
ownedOnTop.hint: Your own tokens are drawn above everyone else's, and take the click when tokens overlap. Only on your screen; nothing on the map changes for anyone else.

ghostPolicyLast.name: Ghost movement mode to restore
ghostPolicyLast.hint: Hidden. The mode (Exploration only or Always allowed) the GM toolbar button restores when it is switched back on.

ghost.name: My ghost button
ghost.hint: Hidden. Whether this player's ghost button is on; it only works while the GM allows ghost movement.

pathfinding.name: Drag pathfinding
pathfinding.hint: When a dragged token would stop at a wall or walk into another token, find the shortest way around (through open doors, never closed ones) and show that path in the ruler; clicking a moving token stops it. Players only route around walls they have seen. Ghost movement and the GM's unconstrained tool still move in a straight line.

pathfindMine.name: Find a path when I drag
pathfindMine.hint: Your drags go around walls and tokens when the GM allows drag pathfinding, with rounded corners where they cost nothing. Only on your screen.

assist.name: Drag help for the table
assist.hint: Off: every drag is plain Foundry dragging (no path round walls, no group plan). The GM's toolbar button (route icon, Token controls) flips it in one click. It also switches itself off after repeated failures, and tells the GM.

groupDrags.name: Group drags out of combat
groupDrags.hint: When several tokens are dragged together outside a fight, each walks its own way to its own spot around the drop point, filing through doors without overlapping. Off: they move as Foundry moves them, stopping before any token in the way.

fightGroupDrags.name: Group drags in a fight (tier C, testing)
fightGroupDrags.hint: When several tokens are dragged together during a fight, moves whose ways do not meet go together and the others set off as the one before them arrives. Off (the default while it is tested): they move as Foundry moves them, stopping before any token in the way, each charged the squares it walks.

assist.on: Drag help on: paths round walls, groups walk together
assist.off: Drag help off: plain Foundry dragging for everyone
assist.clip: One click turns pathfinding and group drags off for the whole table, and back on. Click to stop still works.

breaker.gm: Drag help switched itself off after repeated failures ({why}). Plain Foundry dragging until you turn it back on (route icon, Token controls).
breaker.player: Drag help switched itself off on {user}'s screen after repeated failures ({why}). It is back after their page reloads.

telemetry.filed: Thanks: that move was filed for the GM.
telemetry.noFeedback: The bug report module (Pentaryn Feedback) is not on: nothing was filed.

wrongMove.name: That move was wrong
wrongMove.hint: Files the last ten seconds of drag movement as a bug report for the GM (Pentaryn Feedback).

telemetry.text: That move was wrong (movement hotkey). The last ten seconds of drag movement on this screen:
